packageRules.description: Autonomous loop: auto-merge all npm (dev+runtime, incl. major) on green. The real suite (unit+integration+e2e on a live stack) is the gate — a breaking bump fails CI and never merges.

Default for docker: manual (untested — monitoring, cloudflared, postgrest, meta). CI can't verify them yet; a weekly digest pings so they don't pile silently. Overridden below for candidate-tested images.
Docker majors: manual regardless — larger config surface than the Tier-1 candidate test covers.

Infra images WITH a Tier-1 candidate test (nginx, kong): auto-merge patch/minor/digest, gated by the REQUIRED 'Tier-1 candidate boot' check. Ordered AFTER the general docker rules so it wins (Renovate: later rule overrides). Majors excluded → stay manual via the rule above.
FROZEN stateful trio: auto-update is unsafe (migration/data coupling; storage has NO restore source, so 'roll back on failure' is impossible). Bumped only via a rehearsed restore.
